wish: Count my overdue tasks and warn me when there are more than five

data.message: Assuming you want a counter that shows red warning when overdue > 5

data.content:
### TSK-01: Display Overdue Count [EX]
WHEN the organ loads, THE SYSTEM SHALL show the count of overdue tasks.

### TSK-02: Warning State [EX]
WHEN overdue count exceeds 5, THE SYSTEM SHALL display a red warning indicator.

### TSK-03: Emit Count [PBT]
WHEN task data changes, THE SYSTEM SHALL emit the updated count.
